content:
Maya: Quick: I sketched a pared-down compliance launch plan. We need a clear GA scope so eng can estimate.

Aj: Please paste the sketch. Is this for BYOK+audit only or full SOC2 bundle?

Maya: BYOK (AWS/GCP) + immutable audit export + RBAC for audit UI. SOC2/ISO docs will be "evidence pack" but not an audited cert in GA.

Sofia: Security note: GA must include tamper-evidence (hashing) and key rotation logs. Also, include a threat-model update before signoff.

Priya: Customers asking for multi-year retention. For GA, can we do 12 months by default and paywall longer retention/export?

Aj: Implementation question: support KMIP/HSM or envelope keys only? KMIP adds a lot of scope.

Maya: Proposal: GA = envelope BYOK supporting AWS/GCP KMS + rotation metadata. KMIP/HSM to follow as enterprise add-on.

Sofia: OK as long as we capture HSM attestation requirements in the backlog and have a migration path.

Priya: Customer pilots: I'll line up 2 with retention needs; one needs legal exportability (CSV+WAL) and one needs SOC2-ready artifact mapping.

LegalBot: quick guidance: export must retain original event IDs and timestamps; include a signed manifest for chain-of-custody for audits.

Aj: Rough ETA: core infra + KMS integration + streaming export = 6 weeks (2 Eng), RBAC/UI = 3 weeks, tamper/hash pipeline = 2 weeks parallel. Total ~8 weeks.

Maya: Good. Proposed launch gates:
- Security signoff: threat model + tamper verification
- Core features: KMS + export + RBAC
- Pilot validation: 2 pilots onboarded
- Ops: runbooks + retention SLA docs

Sofia: Addability: monitoring metrics to gate GA: export success rate >99.5%, export latency 95p < 30s, tamper-checks pass on canary data.

Priya: For pilots we'll need an onboarding checklist (credentials, bucket access, rotation window). I'll create one and share in #customer-success.

Aj: One open: bulk export SLA and poison-message handling. We should design idempotent exports and dead-letter for failed batches.

Maya: Agreed. I'll write a short PRD with acceptance criteria per gate. Any objections to 12mo GA retention to accelerate launch?

Sofia: No objection, documented enterprise upgrade path required.

DeployBot: deploy requested for branch compliance/mini-ga -> staging at 2026-03-20T15:02:00Z :rocket:

Maya: thanks, i'll post PRD tomorrow and tag eng/security/legal. :thumbsup:
